   **Bugs and stability.**
      9 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Aug 4, 2026 - Nov 20, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Oksana Borovyk_, Nov 18, 2026, 1/5: "It was great and I even used the premium version… until the app completely changed its interface and is much more annoying to use now. I can’t scroll between days as easily, can’t see all the entries in one spot without having to click around, just overall annoying. The old interface was great. There was a workaround where you can change your location and that unlocks the old interface. Not anymore. The app is unusable. Very unfortunate"
            2. _Thorsten Mootz_, Aug 30, 2026, 1/5: "New update is really bad and user unfriendly. If it's not broken, don't fix it..."
            3. _Harun_, Aug 4, 2026, 1/5: "I have been using this app for more than 10 years now. In the beginning it was the perfect app. But it is too laggy/buggy now. And also there is too much downtime lately. Other than that still an ok app to track macro's. UPDATE: THE LATEST UPDATE ON ANDROID SUCKS UNFORTUNATELY. I CAN'T DELETE A WHOLE MEAL AT ONCE ANYMORY, ALSO DON'T HAVE AN OVERVIEW OF MY MEALS LIKE ON THE WEB VERSION. I'M A PREMIUM USER AND I SERIOUSLY CONSIDER CANCELING MY SUBSCRIPTION! HOPE THIS WILL BE FIXED ASAP!"
